description: HTW Berlin publishes Labels4Rails, a Python tool for annotating railway camera scenes. Its GUI marks track positions and switch states, while package scripts convert annotations into segmentation masks or YOLO labels. The project also describes use with the Norwegian L4R_NLB images from the Trondheim to Bodø route, captured in four seasons; the tool itself is reusable globally and has no fixed observation period. GitHub supplies source code, setup instructions for Linux and Windows, and a GPL 3.0 licence at no cost. The annotations can prepare perception inputs or observation tests for rail-operation simulations. The documented workflow needs Python dependencies and suitable camera geometry; accuracy on other rail networks is uncertain. The tool was not installed or executed. No directly related catalogue platform was identified.
